place.name: Cundinamarca Department
place.description: Cundinamarca (Spanish pronunciation: [kundinaˈmaɾka]) is a department of Colombia. Its area covers 22,623 square kilometres (8,735 sq mi) (not including the Capital District) and it has a population of 2,919,060 as of 2018 (3,445,300, DANE 2023 projections).
